description:
Problem and evidence
In lib/zaq/channels/jido_chat_bridge.ex, do_send_reply/2 routes plans and nonempty attachments to the executor. Its remaining text clause matches attachments: [] and calls send_prepared_reply/4 with []. That helper maps an always-empty prepared list and passes files to handle_send_with_adapter/4, whose attachment-present callback branch cannot run through this caller.

Implementation
Recheck every caller, then simplify the text helpers and their names/signatures around ordinary text delivery. Remove the unused prepared-file argument/conversion and unreachable attachment branch. Keep attachment support in shared create_message and edit_message: the executor still uses them. Do not route text through planning, change send_mode eligibility, replace failed edits with sends, or weaken planned-post confirmation.

Callback invariants
Text creates dispatch on_reply once. Text edits do not dispatch through the unreachable attachment conditional. Planned delivery uses delivery_completed/3 once with the report's final message ID. Preserve these exact distinctions.

Action reuse: keep shared create_message, edit_message, send_mode and dispatch_on_reply; simplify their text orchestration callers only.

Tests
Inspect jido_chat_bridge_test.exs, jido_chat_delivery_test.exs and delivery/executor_test.exs. Remove tests/stubs that only exercise eliminated helper plumbing or an unreachable text-with-attachments branch. Retain create/update request, callback cardinality, failed-edit/no-replacement, text bypass and planned attachment coverage. Coordinate with the legacy-report cleanup because both edit JidoChatBridge.

Authorization and boundaries
User explicitly requested these four cleanup issues on 2026-11-20 and approved removing tests related to this cleanup. Remove tests/fixtures that exist solely for retired APIs, unreachable branches, or unsupported legacy report shapes. Migrate assertions for still-supported behavior to the retained production boundary; do not remove security, byte-integrity, history, callback, or delivery-policy coverage merely because its old entry point disappears. Record the exact deleted tests and retained/migrated coverage in completion notes. This approval does not authorize unrelated behavior changes, dependency publication, commit/push, or final UX/E2E acceptance.

Implementation guidance
Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/services/channels.md, and applicable naming/code-quality guidance. Read docs/documentation.md before updating stale API documentation. Recheck live callers and workspace changes before editing; review evidence was collected at f6a1d3070. No new Action or tool exposure is needed: this is local cleanup of existing Channel operations.

Validation and completion
Run focused affected existing suites and mix q per docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md. Preserve meaningful existing properties; introduce no tests that merely mirror private helpers. Report failures honestly, including unrelated known failures. Final coverage and mix precommit remain under zaq-1lw.13. This issue blocks architecture review zaq-1lw.12; sibling cleanups have no semantic dependency. Coordinate edits with other workers.

comments.text: Action reuse assessment: local-only text orchestration in JidoChatBridge. Serena callers confirm send_prepared_reply/4 is called only by do_send_reply with attachments [] and prepared []; handle_send_with_adapter/4 only by that helper. Reuse send_mode, create_message, edit_message and dispatch_on_reply; prepared_upload remains used by executor send/upload operations. Preserve text creates one callback, edits no callback, no replacement after failed edit, and strict planned confirmation. No Action/tool surface changes. Retain existing bridge/delivery/executor tests; inspect obsolete fixtures before deletion. User approved scoped cleanup; workspace contains only .24 edits.

Implementation complete in working tree: text helpers now take three arguments, skip empty prepared-file conversion, and remove unreachable attachment callback conditional. Shared prepared_upload/create/edit/send_mode and executor path retained. Focused Jido bridge, delivery and executor suites passed; mix q passed. No tests/fixtures removed: all current tests exercise supported public behavior; none reference retired private plumbing. Final coverage/precommit stay in .13; no commit/push; pending integration review/landing.
Exact focused result: 254 passed (5 properties, 249 tests). All .25 requirements verified; no obsolete public-path test/fixture needed deletion.
